entry.title: Bitcoin Core 32.0rc4 is now available
entry.summary:
The latest release candidate for Bitcoin Core, version v32.0rc4, is now available for download. This version represents a significant step towards the final release of Bitcoin Core v32.0, assuming no critical problems are identified during testing. Interested parties can access the binaries from [Bitcoin Core's official website](https://bitcoincore.org/bin/bitcoin-core-32.0/test.rc4) and the source code is accessible under the signed tag on [GitHub](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/tree/v32.0rc4).
For those involved in testing or wanting more detailed information about this release candidate, preliminary release notes have been published and can be viewed [here](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Notes-Draft). Additionally, a comprehensive testing guide is available to assist testers in evaluating the new features and stability of this release; this guide is found at the following [link](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/bitcoin-devwiki/wiki/32.0-Release-Candidate-Testing-Guide).
Feedback and any issues discovered during the testing phase are crucial for the improvement of the final release. Contributors and users are encouraged to report their findings and comments directly on the dedicated GitHub issues page, which can be accessed [here](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36315). The feedback collected will play a vital role in determining whether v32.0rc4 progresses to the official v32.0 release without further modifications.
